item.title: 8-month Iran war looms large over Israeli election
item.description: Israeli voters are choosing their next government, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu insisting only he can finish the job started eight months ago in Iran.

item.title: New charges tossed against ex-FBI officials in Hunter Biden probe
item.description: The unsigned and unsworn superseding complaint comes just hours before the defendants were due to appear in federal court in Washington, D.C. for a preliminary hearing.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO lists 93 pages of risks. What could go wrong?
item.description: Anthropic's planned IPO requires investors to reckon with the threat posed by AI. "This is not an ordinary technology risk," one expert said.

item.title: Serial killer Ted Bundy linked to another Utah girl's cold case murder
item.description: A Utah prosecutor said Ted Bundy was responsible for killing 17-year-old Melissa Ann Smith in 1974, a death that had long been listed as a cold case.

item.title: How often should you update your financial plan?
item.description: Your financial plan shouldn't stay static. Here's when it makes sense to take another look.

item.title: Convicted murderer escapes prison through fence, steals truck
item.description: Authorities say a man serving a life sentence for murder escaped from a prison in northwest Tennessee, stole a truck and remained at large early Tuesday.

item.title: Dollar General overcharged people at checkout for years, FTC says
item.description: The discount retailer routinely charges customers more at checkout than the prices it displays on shelves, price tags and ads, according to federal and state authorities.

item.title: Alex Pretti's parents says they haven't heard from the federal government about his death
item.description: Alex Pretti's parents spoke publicly for the first time since he was fatally shot by a federal agent in Minnesota in January.

item.title: Florida Senate race heats up between Angie Nixon and Ashley Moody
item.description: The Florida race between state Democratic Rep. Angie Nixon and GOP Sen. Ashley Moody is heating up with one week left until the midterm elections. Cristian Benavides has more.

item.title: Zookeeper dies after being attacked by leopard, safari park says
item.description: The woman was attacked while caring for two Persian leopards in an indoor facility at the Beekse Bergen park in the south of the Netherlands.

item.title: Florida mom arrested at airport after leaving 4 kids home alone while on Vegas business trip
item.description: A Florida mother was arrested at the Orlando International Airport after leaving her four children home unsupervised while on a business trip in Las Vegas. She did have a babysitter check on them before and after school, authorities said.

item.title: Former U.S. ambassador to Israel on how Gaza war affects Netanyahu's reelection chances
item.description: Former U.S. ambassador to Israel Edward Djerejian breaks down how the war in Gaza has impacted Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's chance at reelection.

item.title: FBI searches home tied to former California Rep. Eric Swalwell
item.description: The FBI searched a home connected to Eric Swalwell as part of an investigation into the former California congressman, who dropped out of the governor's race and gave up his seat following sexual assault allegations.

item.title: British duo charged in alleged Iran-linked RAF Fairford plot to appear in court
item.description: Two British men have been charged with national security offenses after an incident at RAF Fairford, a British air base used by the U.S. CBS News' Inaya Iman reports.

item.title: DOJ asks Washington to set aside ballots from 400 alleged noncitizens
item.description: Federal prosecutors said they sent a letter to the Washington secretary of state with a list of 400 people they claimed are not U.S. citizens.

item.title: Israelis living abroad spend thousands to fly in to vote in crucial election
item.description: Tens of thousands of Israelis living abroad have flown in just to cast their ballots in an election many voters see as a referendum on Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: Voters motivated by economic frustration, Democratic strategist says
item.description: Early voting is underway in some states. Ameshia Cross, a Democratic strategist who also served as a communications adviser on former President Barack Obama's 2012 reelection campaign, weighs in on the 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: Trump says Obama "wouldn't understand" White House renovations
item.description: "I would try and explain that to a guy like Obama, but he wouldn't understand," President Trump said at a rally in Mississippi.

item.title: Ceasefire begins in Russian-occupied Ukrainian town as strikes on Kyiv continue
item.description: Russia's strikes on Ukraine continue, but a localized ceasefire has started in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, where residents face dire conditions. CBS News' Aidan Stretch has the latest from Ukraine.

item.title: High airfares are weighing on Thanksgiving travel plans this year
item.description: Average fares for the Thanksgiving holiday were up 31% in August from a year ago, according to aviation pricing data.

item.title: John Thune's balancing act: Inside his push to save the GOP majority
item.description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune has tried to balance passing the president's agenda and preserving the independence of the Senate. The midterms are his biggest test yet.

item.title: Former Bee & Co. employee recalls high-pressure sales tactics
item.description: Since a CBS California Investigates report first aired in August, Bee & Co. stores at Westfield Topanga in Canoga Park and Del Amo Fashion Center in Torrance have closed their doors permanently.

item.title: Greenhouse gas levels set records again in 2025, U.N. says
item.description: Greenhouse gas concentrations in the atmosphere rose to record highs in 2025, locking in climate​ impacts that will persist for centuries, the U.N. says.

item.title: In Trump's pardon economy, victims lost out on $119M in restitution
item.description: Small businesses and retirees are left empty-handed as fraudsters, some represented by Trump allies, win clemency.

item.title: Hospital beds for the nation's sickest kids are disappearing
item.description: Hospitals nationwide are cutting intensive services for kids in critical care. Many cite too few patients, staffing shortages, and money problems.

item.title: Jay-Z to headline 2027 Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: The NFL, Apple Music and Roc Nation announced Monday night that Jay-Z will be the featured performer for the halftime festivities on Feb. 14 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.

item.title: Video of police being called to youth soccer game draws outrage
item.description: One of the league's directors said the parents were being disruptive, but 3-year-old Nevada's mother said, "They're literally kicking him out of this place because he's good at soccer."

item.title: Does America Need More Police? With Malcolm Gladwell
item.description: Malcolm Gladwell argues that America has been dishonest about gun violence and explains why he believes reducing murders requires more police, not fewer. If you'd like to share your own great question, email us at greatquestion@cbsnews.com.

item.title: Is the Federal Reserve likely to raise interest rates this week?
item.description: Fed officials will unveil their latest interest rate move this week, following the September rate hike, the first in three years.

item.title: Did High-Speed Rail help consultants "manipulate" a bid to win a lucrative contract?
item.description: Records show California High-Speed Rail knew a winning contract bid relied on "artificially low" rates that the consulting firm never intended to charge.
